description: 🌊 The original agent harness. Deploy intelligent multi-player swarms, coordinate autonomous workflows, and build conversational AI systems. Features adaptive memory, self-learning intelligence, federation, vector RAG integration, and native Claude Code / Codex / Hermes and many more Integrated
vibe: Orchestration is a ledger, execution is your job — never confuse the two.
highlights: Hard separation of concerns: claude-flow is a coordination ledger, Codex is the executor that writes code and runs commands.
Explicit anti-pattern warnings: never stop after calling claude-flow; immediately continue with your own work.
Policy-governed workflow with hard invariants: never run two writers in one worktree, delegation only reduces capabilities, policy denial cancels dependent work.
Release contract enforces exact package train, clean source state, and version lockstep across latest/alpha/v3alpha.
Memory-first loop: search memory before starting, store patterns after success, use score > 0.7 as reuse threshold.
assessment: This guide excels by ruthlessly eliminating a common agent failure mode: mistaking orchestration for execution. The repeated, visually distinct warnings and concrete wrong/right examples make the division of labor impossible to misread. The policy invariants and release contract add a layer of safety and reproducibility that is rare in agent instructions, showing a systems mindset that values correctness over convenience.
